kate: Heads-up: final GA readiness checklist — need owners for SLA doc, runbook, monitoring, pricing note. Freeze in ~18h.

noah: I can take SLA doc + SLI defs. Will open a short PR tonight with p50/p95 and measurement windows.

luis: I9ll own runbook & incident comms. Will add fallback patterns (route to smaller model variant, cached response) and an initial comms template.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: prod-freeze scheduled to start in ~18h. Post blockers in #release-war-room.

noah: Draft SLOs: availability 99.6% (monthly), hosted latency p50 180ms, p95 750ms. Dedicated contractual p95 relaxed to 1.1s. Will include alert hints.

luis: Monitoring asks: dash panels for latency_by_model, kv_cache_hit_rate, batching_ratio, fallback_rate. Propose alert: fallback_rate > 1% sustained for 5m.

kate: Plan: I9ll compile a 1-page Confluence checklist linking PRs and owners, publish public SLOs on the service expectations page (note: contract overrides), and ping execs after legal signs off.

luis: ack

noah: ack :thumbsup:

sre-bot: reminder: final safety-net requests in #release-war-room.
